item.title: Weekly VSCode Grumbling
item.summary: Why is it constantly changing and most basic problems are under the rug? Long time ago I reported it and went to backlog or sg. It may seem like a minor issue, but it can be quite frustrating and has a straightforward fix. When scrolling horizontally, it's not apparent that the characters are still there, they're simply not visible. https://i.postimg.cc/C5bN0CQT/vscode.jpg Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49286184 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
